dataset_title: Provincial Population, Annual Population Growth Rate, and Population Density by Year
dataset_title_tr: Yıllara Göre İl Nüfusları, Yıllık Nüfus Artış Hızı ve Nüfus Yoğunluğu
notes: Combines ADNKS total population (DF_ADNKS_T30) with annual growth rate and density (DF_ADNKS_T29) for 2007-2025.

dataset_title: Population by Province, 5-Year Age Group, and Sex
dataset_title_tr: İl, Yaş Grubu ve Cinsiyete Göre Nüfus
notes: Covers 10-year series (2016-2025) across all 19 five-year age brackets (0-4 to 90+) and total by sex (total, male, female).

dataset_title: Population by Broad Age Groups, Median Age by Sex, and Age Dependency Ratios
dataset_title_tr: Geniş Yaş Grupları, Ortanca Yaş ve Yaş Bağımlılık Oranları
notes: Combines DF_ADNKS_T35 (broad age groups), DF_ADNKS_T23 (median age by sex), and DF_ADNKS_T24 (dependency ratios) for 2007-2025.

dataset_title: Population by Administrative Urban/Rural Centers (2007-2025) and DEGURBA Classification (2022-2025)
dataset_title_tr: İl/İlçe Merkezi - Belde/Köy Nüfusu ve Kent-Kır (DEGURBA) Sınıflamasına Göre İl Nüfusları
notes: Includes administrative urban/rural split (2007-2025, DF_ADNKS_T14) and new spatial grid DEGURBA dense urban / intermediate urban / rural split (2022-2025, DF_ADNKS_T37).

dataset_title: Crude Birth Rate, Total Fertility Rate, and Mean Age of Mother by Province
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Kaba Doğum Hızı, Toplam Doğurganlık Hızı ve Annenin Ortalama Yaşı
notes: Covers 2009-2025 for crude birth rate, total fertility rate, and mean age of mother at birth; 2014-2025 for mean age at first birth.

dataset_title: Provincial Mortality Rates (Crude, Infant, Under-5, Suicide) and Life Expectancy at Birth
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Ölüm Hızları (Kaba, Bebek, Beş Yaş Altı, İntihar) ve Doğuşta Beklenen Yaşam Süreleri
notes: Mortality rates cover 2009-2025; Life Tables life expectancy at birth covers multi-year periods up to 2021-2023.

dataset_title: Deaths by Province and Selected Causes of Death
dataset_title_tr: İl ve Seçilmiş Ölüm Nedenlerine Göre Ölümler
notes: Covers 2018-2025 across all 81 provinces. Cells with '-' (e.g., zero/unreported COVID-19 deaths outside pandemic years) are preserved as empty string.

dataset_title: Provincial Population Projections and Projected Average Annual Growth Rate (2023-2030)
dataset_title_tr: Nüfus Projeksiyonları: Yıllara Göre İl Nüfusları ve Yıllık Ortalama Artış Hızları (2023-2030)
notes: Official TÜİK main scenario projections for all 81 provinces (2023 ADNKS baseline + 2024-2030 annual projections).

dataset_title: Average Household Size and Number of Households by Family Composition Type by Province
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Ortalama Hanehalkı Büyüklüğü ve Hanehalkı Tiplerine Göre Hanehalkı Sayısı
notes: Average household size covers 2008-2025 (DF_ADNKS_T25); detailed household family composition covers 2014-2025 (DF_ADNKS_T06 & DF_ADNKS_T08).

dataset_title: Population Aged 15+ by Province, Marital Status, and Sex
dataset_title_tr: İl, Medeni Durum ve Cinsiyete Göre Nüfus (15+ Yaş)
notes: Covers 2008-2025 across all 81 provinces.

dataset_title: Marriages, Divorces, Mean Age at First Marriage, and Consanguineous Marriages by Province
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Evlenme, Boşanma, Ortalama İlk Evlenme Yaşı ve Akraba Evliliği İstatistikleri
notes: Covers 2001-2025 for marriages, divorces, and mean age at first marriage; 2010-2025 for consanguineous marriages.

dataset_title: Population Aged 15+ by Attained Education Level and Sex by Province
dataset_title_tr: Bitirilen Eğitim Durumuna ve Cinsiyete Göre Nüfus (15+ Yaş)
notes: Covers 2008-2025 across all 81 provinces from the National Education Statistics Database (Ulusal Eğitim İstatistikleri Veri Tabanı).

dataset_title: Mean Years of Schooling, School Life Expectancy (ISCED 0, 1-3, 1-8), and Gender Parity Index by Province
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Ortalama Eğitim Süresi, Muhtemel Eğitim Süresi (ISCED 0, 1-3, 1-8) ve Cinsiyet Eşitliği Endeksi
notes: Mean years of schooling covers 2011-2025; school life expectancy and gender parity index cover 2018-2025.

dataset_title: Provincial Literacy (Age 6+, 2008-2025) and Non-Formal Education Institutions, Participants, and Graduates
dataset_title_tr: İl ve Cinsiyete Göre Okuryazarlık (6+ Yaş, 2008-2025) ve Yaygın Eğitim İstatistikleri
notes: Combines 2008-2025 6+ illiteracy time series (DF_ULUSAL_EGITIM_ISTATISTIK_BED_NUFUS), 2021 Census literacy counts, and non-formal education statistics.

dataset_title: Provincial Headline Labor Force Indicators (LFPR, Employment Rate, Unemployment Rate and 95% CIs)
dataset_title_tr: İl Düzeyinde Temel İşgücü Göstergeleri (İşgücüne Katılma, İstihdam ve İşsizlik Oranları)
notes: Covers 2022-2025 across all 81 provinces using TÜİK small-area estimation / Household Labour Force Survey model estimates.

dataset_title: Provincial Per Capita GDP (TRY & USD) and GDP by Economic Activity (NACE Rev.2 A10) at Current Prices
dataset_title_tr: İl Bazında Kişi Başına GSYH (TL ve Dolar) ve İktisadi Faaliyet Kollarına (A10) Göre GSYH
notes: Complete 25-year series (2000-2024) for all 81 provinces.

dataset_title: Provincial Socioeconomic Status (SES, 2023), Human Development Index (HDI, 2018-2022), and Human Capital Index (HCI, 2021-2023)
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Sosyoekonomik Seviye (SES, 2023), Beşeri Kalkınma Endeksi (2018-2022) ve Beşeri Sermaye Endeksi (2021-2023)
notes: Combines TÜİK's official provincial Socioeconomic Status (SES) household distribution (A+ to E), Human Development Index (DF_BESERI_KALKINMA_ENDEKS), and Human Capital Index.

dataset_title: Building and Dwelling Characteristics by Province: Ownership, Rooms, Heating, Fuel, Building Age, Floors, Elevator & Parking (2021)
dataset_title_tr: Bina ve Konut Nitelikleri Araştırması: İllere Göre Konut Mülkiyeti, Oda Sayısı, Isıtma Sistemi, Yakıt Türü, Bina Yaşı ve Kat Sayısı (2021)
notes: Comprehensive 43-indicator synthesis of all 9 provincial tables from TÜİK's 2021 Population and Housing Census / Survey on Building and Dwelling Characteristics.

dataset_title: Provincial House and Commercial Property Sales by Type (2013-2025) and Dwellings Granted Building Permits (2010-2025)
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Konut ve İş Yeri Satış Sayıları (2013-2025) ile Yapı Belgesi Verilen Daire Sayıları (2010-2025)
notes: Combines annual property sales (DF_SATIS_SEKLI_DURUMU_ILILCE_V3) and annual construction/occupancy permits for dwellings.

dataset_title: Provincial Internal In-Migration, Out-Migration, Net Migration Rate, and Lifetime Migration Stock (Place of Birth Status)
dataset_title_tr: İllerin Aldığı Göç, Verdiği Göç, Net Göç Hızı (2008-2024) ve Doğum Yeri Durumuna Göre Nüfus (2014-2025)
notes: Internal migration flow series (2008-2024) plus lifetime birth-province vs residence-province stock (DF_ADNKS_T4_V1_2, 2014-2025).

dataset_title: Provincial Internal In-Migration and Out-Migration by Reason for Migration (2018-2025)
dataset_title_tr: Göç Etme Nedenine Göre İllerin Aldığı ve Verdiği İç Göç (2018-2025)
notes: Covers all 12 migration reason categories (including post-2023 earthquake hometown return flows) across all 81 provinces for 2018-2025.

dataset_title: Provincial International Migration by Sex and Citizenship (2016-2025) and Foreign Resident Population (2007-2025)
dataset_title_tr: İllere, Cinsiyete ve Vatandaşlığa Göre Uluslararası Göç (2016-2025) ve Yabancı Nüfus (2007-2025)
notes: Combines international immigration/emigration flows (2016-2025) with ADNKS foreign resident population stock (DF_ADNKS_T12, 2007-2025).

dataset_title: Registered Road Motor Vehicles (Year-End, 2005-2025) and Annual Transferred Vehicles (2010-2025) by Type and Province
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Motorlu Kara Taşıtları Sayısı (2005-2025) ve Devri Yapılan Motorlu Kara Taşıtları Sayısı (2010-2025)
notes: Covers all 9 vehicle categories (car, minibus, bus, small truck, truck, motorcycle, special purpose, tractor, total) across all 81 provinces.

dataset_title: Number of Road Traffic Accidents, Persons Killed, and Persons Injured by Province (2015-2025)
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Trafik Kaza, Ölü ve Yaralı Sayısı (2015-2025)
notes: Covers 2015-2025 across all 81 provinces.

dataset_title: Commercial Airport Aircraft Traffic, Passengers, and Freight by Province (2004-2025)
dataset_title_tr: İBBS'ye Göre Havalimanlarında İniş-Kalkış Yapan Uçak Sayısı ile İç ve Dış Hatlarda Yolcu ve Yük Taşıma (2004-2025)
notes: Covers the 54 provinces with commercial airports (provinces without airports have no observations). Multi-airport provinces (İstanbul, Antalya, Muğla, Balıkesir, Çanakkale, Adana) are summed to province totals; Rize-Artvin Airport is assigned to Rize (53/TR904).

dataset_title: Provincial Well-Being Index (41 Indicators, 11 Dimension Scores & Ranks, 2015) and Happiness Level by Sex (2013)
dataset_title_tr: İllerde Yaşam Endeksi Gösterge Değerleri, Boyut Endeksleri ve Sıralamaları (2015) ile İllere ve Cinsiyete Göre Mutluluk Düzeyi (2013)
unit: applications_per_doctor; index; m2_per_1000_persons; per_100_persons; per_million; per_thousand; percent; points; rank; rooms; try; ug_per_m3; year
notes: Contains all 41 underlying provincial indicators (internet subscriptions per 100 persons, shopping mall area, public transport satisfaction, night safety, daily earnings, savings per capita, PM10, etc.) plus 12 index/rank pairs and sex-disaggregated happiness rates.

dataset_title: Provincial Sports Clubs by Type (2007-2014) and Print/Internet News Media Publishing Official Announcements (2024)
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Spor Kulüpleri (2007-2014) ve Resmi İlan Yayımlayan Süreli Yayın / İnternet Haber Siteleri (2024)
notes: Covers all 81 provinces for sports clubs by type and official print/internet news media.

dataset_title: Opera and Ballet Halls, Seats, Shows, Performances, and Audiences by Province (2023-2024 and 2024-2025 Seasons)
dataset_title_tr: Opera ve Bale Salonu Bulunan İllerde Oynanan Eser, Gösteri ve Seyirci Sayısı (2023-2024 ve 2024-2025 Sezonları)
notes: Partial coverage (6/81 provinces): Only Ankara, Antalya, İstanbul, İzmir, Mersin, and Samsun have State Opera and Ballet (Devlet Opera ve Balesi) halls; the remaining 75 provinces do not have opera/ballet halls.

dataset_title: Hospitals, Hospital Beds by Institution Type, and Health Care Professionals by Category and Province (2002-2024)
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Hastane Sayısı, Hastane Yatak Sayısı ve Sağlık Personeli Sayıları (2002-2024)
publisher: Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK) / Ministry of Health
notes: Complete 23-year time series (2002-2024) across all 81 provinces from Ministry of Health / TÜİK Health Statistics.

dataset_title: Provincial Agricultural Land by Crop and Land Use Type (2020-2025)
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Tarım Alanları (2020-2025)
notes: Covers all 81 provinces for 2020-2025 in decares (excluding permanent meadows and pastures).

dataset_title: Average Daily Wages of Seasonal Agricultural Workers and Monthly Wages of Permanent Agricultural Workers by Province and Sex
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Tarımsal İşletme İşgücü Ücretleri (Mevsimlik Günlük ve Sürekli Aylık Ücretler)
notes: Partial coverage: Covers provinces with sufficient sample size in the Agricultural Holdings Labor Wage Survey; cells marked '-' (no observation) or 'c' (confidential/insufficient sample) are left empty.

dataset_title: Municipal Water Abstraction, Distribution, Wastewater Discharge, and Solid Waste Services by Province (2020, 2022, 2024)
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Belediye Su, Atıksu ve Atık Hizmeti İstatistikleri (2020, 2022, 2024)
unit: count; kg_per_capita_day; percent; person; thousand_m3; ton
notes: Biennial municipal environmental survey covering all 81 provinces for 2020, 2022, and 2024.

dataset_title: Convicts Received into Prison by Permanent Residence Province and Type of Crime (2011-2020)
dataset_title_tr: İBBS 3. Düzeyde Daimi İkametgah ve Suç Türüne Göre Ceza İnfaz Kurumuna Giren Hükümlüler (2011-2020)
notes: Covers 20 crime categories across all 81 provinces for 2011-2020.

dataset_title: Long-Term Provincial Temperature, Sunshine Duration, and Precipitation Normals & Extremes
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Uzun Yıllar Sıcaklık, Güneşlenme ve Yağış İstatistikleri (MGM Resmi İstatistikler)
notes: Fetched and verified HTTP 200 OK across all 81 provincial station pages (?m=ADANA through ?m=DUZCE) from General Directorate of Meteorology (MGM). Annual figures follow MGM's official formula (mean of 12 months for temperature/sunshine, sum of 12 months for precipitation and rainy days, max/min across 12 months for extremes).

dataset_title: Active Enterprises by Province, NACE Rev.2 Economic Activity Section, and Employee Size Group (2014-2024)
dataset_title_tr: İllere, Ekonomik Faaliyet Kollarına (NACE Rev.2) ve Büyüklük Grubuna Göre Aktif Girişim Sayısı
notes: Combined from TÜİK Business Registers SDMX dataflows DF_BR_FAALIYET_BUYUKLUK_GIRISIM_IBBS3_14_18_V1, _19_23, and _24_28 across all 81 provinces (2014-2024), covering all 18 NACE Rev.2 sections (A-S) and 5 employee size classes.

dataset_title: Public Libraries and Educational Institution Libraries, Books, and Beneficiaries by Province
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Halk Kütüphaneleri ile Örgün ve Yaygın Eğitim Kurum Kütüphaneleri İstatistikleri
notes: Extracted from TÜİK Library Statistics Press Release 58308 (Table 4 for 2024-2025 formal/non-formal school libraries and Table 5 for 2025 public libraries) across all 81 provinces.

dataset_title: Satisfaction Rates with Municipal and Public Services by Province
dataset_title_tr: İllere Göre Belediye ve Kamu Hizmetlerinden Memnuniyet Düzeyi
notes: Official provincial-level Life Satisfaction Survey benchmark tables (41_t230, 41_t231, 41_t232, 41_t233) covering 10 municipal services (public transit, waste, water, sewerage, green spaces, roads, lighting, disabled access, social aid) and 6 national public services across all 81 provinces.

dataset_title: Ankara District-Level Population and Annual Population Growth Rate (25 Districts, 2024-2025)
dataset_title_tr: Ankara İlçelerine Göre Nüfus ve Yıllık Nüfus Artış Hızı (ADNKS)
notes: Official ADNKS district population (DF_ADNKS_T22) and annual growth rate per thousand (DF_ADNKS_T38) across all 25 districts of Ankara. The sum of the 25 districts equals Ankara's exact provincial population: 5,864,049 in 2024 and 5,910,320 in 2025.

dataset_title: Ankara District-Level Live Births (by Sex), Marriages, and Divorces (25 Districts, 2014-2025)
dataset_title_tr: Ankara İlçelerine Göre Doğum, Evlenme ve Boşanma İstatistikleri (2014-2025)
notes: 12-year district-level time series (2014-2025) across all 25 districts of Ankara extracted from TÜİK databrowser2 cubes DF_DOGUM_IL_ILCE_C, DF_EVLENME_IL_ILCE, and DF_BOSANMA_IL_ILCE.

dataset_title: Ankara District-Level Socioeconomic Status (SES) Score, Household Class Shares (2023), and Property Sales to Foreigners (2013-2025)
dataset_title_tr: Ankara İlçelerine Göre Sosyoekonomik Seviye (SES) Skoru, Hanehalkı Sınıf Dağılımı ve Yabancılara Gayrimenkul Satışları
notes: Combines all 25 Ankara districts' Socioeconomic Status (SES) scores and 5-tier household class shares (A/A+, B, C1/C2, D, E) from TÜİK Press Release 57942 with 2013-2025 district-level house and commercial property sales to foreigners (DF_YABANCILARA_SATILAR_ILILCE_V3).

dataset_title: Ankara Public Transport (EGO Bus 5 Regional Divisions, Metro M1-M4, Ankaray, Başkentray, and District Transit Lines) Statistics (2021-2026)
dataset_title_tr: Ankara EGO Otobüs Bölge Müdürlükleri, Metro (M1-M4), Ankaray, Başkentray ve İlçe Ulaşım Hatları İstatistikleri (2021-2026)
publisher: Ankara Metropolitan Municipality — EGO General Directorate
unit: count; km; km_per_hour; kwh; meter; person; tl; vehicle
notes: Compiled from official EGO General Directorate statistics PDFs (34953, 34954, 34955, 34956 at ego.gov.tr/tr/sayfa/61/istatistikler) and the EGO 2025 Annual Activity Report (34658 at ego.gov.tr/tr/sayfa/56/stratejik-program). Covers EGO Bus 5 regional divisions, Ankaray, Metro M1-M4, Teleferik, TCDD Başkentray, ÖHO/ÖTA private buses, and 10 district commuter corridors.
